D1-02-abo-blood-groups-antigen

Diagram of the four ABO blood groups in four columns headed A, B, AB and O. In each column, draw a large red blood cell (red biconcave disc) with the correct surface antigens: small blue triangles for antigen A and small green squares for antigen B (group A: triangles only; group B: squares only; group AB: both; group O: none). Below each cell, draw a pale yellow plasma box containing Y-shaped antibodies: green Y-shapes with square-shaped notches for anti-B and blue Y-shapes with triangle-shaped notches for anti-A (group A: anti-B only; group B: anti-A only; group AB: none; group O: both).
D1-03-continuous-discontinuous-variation-graphs

Two graphs side by side. Left graph titled area for "Continuous variation": a histogram of touching vertical bars of increasing then decreasing height, in soft blue, with a smooth bell-shaped curve drawn over the top in dark blue; x-axis shows a measured value, y-axis shows number of individuals. Right graph for "Discontinuous variation": a bar chart with four separate orange bars with clear gaps between them, of different heights (tallest first, then two medium, then a short one), representing blood groups. ABO blood group)", "Number of pupils" on both y-axes, "Height (cm)" on the left x-axis, "O", "A", "B", "AB" under the four right-hand bars, "normal curve" pointing to the smooth curve, "no gaps between bars", "gaps between bars".
D1-04-gene-environment-interaction-flowchart

Concept diagram with three coloured boxes feeding arrows into a central box. Left box (green) shows a DNA double helix and a pair of chromosomes. Top-right box (orange) shows a plate of food, a sun and a small thermometer. Bottom-right box (blue) shows a shaded forest plant beside the same kind of plant in open sun. Arrows from all three point to a central box showing two pupils of the same age with different heights.
D1-06-height-distribution-histogram

A histogram of the invented sample heights of 40 pupils. The x-axis is marked with eight touching class bars: 140–144, 145–149, 150–154, 155–159, 160–164, 165–169, 170–174, 175–179 cm. Bar heights (frequency) are 1, 3, 6, 10, 11, 6, 2 and 1, drawn in soft blue with thin dark outlines and no gaps between bars. The y-axis runs from 0 to 12 with gridlines every 2. A smooth dark blue bell-shaped curve joins the midpoints of the bar tops.
D1-07-weight-distribution-histogram

A histogram of the invented sample weights of 40 pupils. Seven touching bars in soft green for the classes 35–39, 40–44, 45–49, 50–54, 55–59, 60–64 and 65–69 kg, with heights 2, 5, 9, 12, 7, 4 and 1. The y-axis runs from 0 to 14. A smooth dark green curve joins the midpoints of the bar tops, slightly longer on the right side.
D1-09-fingerprint-pattern-types

Four enlarged fingerprint patterns in a row, drawn as clean dark-grey ridge lines on white. 1: plain arch, ridges flowing from left to right rising in a gentle hill in the middle. 2: loop, ridges entering from the left, curving round in a hairpin and leaving on the left, with a small triangular delta on the right. 3: whorl, concentric circular-to-spiral ridges around a central core, with a delta on each side. 4: composite (double loop), two interlocking loops curving round each other in an S-shape, with two deltas.
D1-10-blood-agglutination-test-tile

A white tile with four rows of results, each row showing two circular drops of blood side by side, the left drop mixed with anti-A serum and the right with anti-B serum. Row 1: left drop clumped (grainy dark red specks on pale background), right drop smooth and even. Row 2: left smooth, right clumped. Row 3: both clumped. Row 4: both smooth.
D1-11-discontinuous-variation-bar-charts

Three small bar charts side by side, each with separate bars and gaps between them, in soft colours. Chart 1: two bars, "Rollers" (28) and "Non-rollers" (12). Chart 2: two bars, "Tasters" (29) and "Non-tasters" (11). Chart 3: four bars for blood groups O (21), A (9), B (8), AB (2). Each y-axis from 0 to 30.
D1-13-blood-group-paternity-exclusion

Paternity diagram. A mother figure labelled with a blue "A" badge and a child figure labelled with a green "B" badge connected by a line. Two possible fathers stand to the right: Man 1 with a grey "O" badge and a red cross beside him, Man 2 with a green "B" badge and an orange question mark beside him. Small allele tags under each person: mother "I^A i", child "I^B i", Man 1 "i i", Man 2 "I^B I^B or I^B i".
D1-14-dna-gel-electrophoresis-fingerprint

A simplified DNA fingerprint gel with five vertical lanes on a pale grey rectangle. Each lane contains six to eight dark horizontal bands at different heights, like barcodes. Lane 1 "crime scene sample" has the same band pattern as lane 3 "Suspect 2". Lanes 2 and 4 ("Suspect 1", "Suspect 3") have clearly different patterns. Lane 5 "victim" has another different pattern. A small arrow at the side shows the direction DNA moves from top (negative electrode, wells) to bottom (positive electrode).
D1-01-intraspecific-colour-variation-panel

A grid of six small panels showing colour variation within single species. Panel 1: three West African Dwarf goats side by side, one black, one brown, one black-and-white patched. Panel 2: four Nigerian village chickens with different feather colours: black, white, reddish-brown and speckled grey. Panel 3: three human hands of different skin shades, from very dark brown to light brown, plus one very pale hand to represent albinism. Panel 4: four close-up human eyes with irises in dark brown, light brown, hazel and grey-blue. Panel 5: three Tilapia fish with different scale colours (dark grey, silvery, and with vertical dark bars). Panel 6: three guinea fowl, pearl-grey spotted, white and lavender. Soft natural colours.
D1-05-measuring-student-height-weight

A school pupil in uniform, barefoot, standing straight against a classroom wall with heels, back and head touching the wall. A vertical measuring tape is fixed to the wall from the floor, and a teacher holds a flat ruler level on top of the pupil's head, reading the tape at eye level. Beside them, a second pupil stands barefoot on a bathroom weighing scale on a level floor.
D1-08-field-notebook-biological-variation

A field-notebook style page showing colour patterns in plants and animals. Top row (plants): a variegated croton leaf with green, yellow and red patches; four hibiscus flowers in red, pink, yellow and white; a maize cob with mixed yellow, white and purple grains; three cowpea seeds (white, brown, black-eyed). Bottom row (animals): a speckled chicken feather beside a plain black one; a land snail shell with dark bands beside a plain shell; two butterflies of the same species with slightly different wing patterns.
D1-12-abo-blood-transfusion-compatibility

Arrow diagram of ABO transfusion compatibility. Four large circles arranged in a diamond: O at the top, A on the left, B on the right, AB at the bottom, each coloured softly (O white with red outline, A blue, B green, AB purple). Green arrows show safe donation: from O to A, O to B, O to AB; from A to AB; from B to AB; plus a small curved self-arrow on each circle showing each group can donate to itself. No arrows between A and B.
